# Chris Izworski

## Summary

Chris Izworski is a Bay City, Michigan public-safety technologist, writer, gardener, and publisher of practical local-information projects. His public record includes Bay County 911, Saginaw County 911, Michigan emergency communications work, Great Lakes and Saginaw Bay writing, Michigan Outdoors Now, Great Lakes Levels, Michigan Trout Report, Michigan Birding Report, GitHub Pages, YouTube, ORCID, Wikidata, Medium, and Freighter View Farms.

The canonical website is https://chrisizworski.com/.
The canonical Person ID is https://chrisizworski.com/#person.
Current role: Solutions Consultant at Prepared.

## Isle Royale Interactive Map

- Canonical tool: https://chrisizworski.com/isle-royale-map/
- Source catalog: https://chrisizworski.com/isle-royale-map/catalog.json
- Primary purpose: source-transparent Isle Royale planning map for trails, campgrounds, visitor places, water routes, lighthouses, shipwrecks, boating zones, geology, vegetation, and historical maps.
- Current visitor authority: https://www.nps.gov/isro/planyourvisit/mapsbrochures.htm
- Truth rule: current NPS/federal/open GIS is preferred over static map artwork; historical, science, and derived layers retain visible source/vintage status; the tool is not a navigation chart.

- Michigan Leaf-Peeping Planner: https://chrisizworski.com/fall-color/michigan-leaf-peeping-planner/
- Decision flow: current regional status -> best region this weekend -> peak timing -> route planning.
- Truth rule: seasonal timing is the base model. Live weather is a planning input and is not represented as a statewide direct leaf measurement.

## Mackinac Bridge Planning Tools

- Live crossing tool: https://chrisizworski.com/mackinac-bridge-live/
- RV and trailer wind rules: https://chrisizworski.com/mackinac-bridge-rv-trailer-wind-rules/
- Driver assistance guide: https://chrisizworski.com/mackinac-bridge-driver-assistance/
- Toll calculator and fare guide: https://chrisizworski.com/mackinac-bridge-tolls/
- Primary status source: https://www.mackinacbridge.org/fares-traffic/conditions/
- Camera source: https://www.mackinacbridge.org/fares-traffic/bridge-cam/
- Wind-rule source: https://www.michigan.gov/mdot/about/faqs/bridges/wind
- Fare source: https://www.mackinacbridge.org/fares-traffic/fare-schedule/
- Driver-assistance source: https://www.mackinacbridge.org/fares-traffic/transport-services/
- Truth rule: The live tool treats the Mackinac Bridge Authority condition report as authoritative. Nearby NOAA observations and the NWS Mackinaw City forecast are explicitly labeled as off-bridge context and never presented as an official bridge-deck wind.

## Great Lakes Ship Tracking

- Live lake-wide AIS tool: https://chrisizworski.com/great-lakes-freighter-tracking/
- Dedicated Soo Locks tool: https://chrisizworski.com/soo-locks/
- NOAA Great Lakes conditions: https://chrisizworski.com/great-lakes-buoys/
- Named passage activity: https://ais.boatnerd.com/
- AIS embed provider: https://www.myshiptracking.com/more/embed-our-map
- Primary AIS background source: https://greatlakes-seaway.com/en/commercial-shipping/transiting-the-seaway/automatic-identification-system-ais/
- Coverage: All five lakes with quick views for the Soo Locks, Straits of Mackinac, Duluth-Superior, Port Huron, Detroit River, and Saginaw Bay.
- Truth rule: Public AIS positions may be delayed, incomplete, or unavailable. Nearby NOAA station observations are regional context rather than conditions aboard a vessel. The tool does not copy or republish BoatNerd named-vessel schedules and must not be used for navigation.

## Great Lakes Gazette

- Daily newspaper landing page: https://chrisizworski.com/great-lakes-gazette/
- Current edition: https://gazette.chrisizworski.com/
- Permanent issue archive: https://gazette.chrisizworski.com/archive
- RSS feed: https://gazette.chrisizworski.com/feed.xml
- Latest edition data: https://gazette.chrisizworski.com/api/latest
- Coverage: Current Great Lakes vessel movements, ports, NOAA lake levels, NWS marine forecasts, and one dated item to watch in the next edition.
- Freshness rule: Vessel news and port reports older than 48 hours are excluded from the current-news context. Public AIS may be delayed or incomplete and is not a navigation source.

## Michigan Ontario Border Crossing Tools

- Live five-crossing dashboard: https://chrisizworski.com/michigan-border-wait-times/
- Gordie Howe International Bridge: https://chrisizworski.com/gordie-howe-bridge-wait-time/
- Ambassador Bridge: https://chrisizworski.com/ambassador-bridge-wait-time/
- Detroit Windsor Tunnel: https://chrisizworski.com/detroit-windsor-tunnel-wait-time/
- Blue Water Bridge: https://chrisizworski.com/blue-water-bridge-wait-time/
- Sault Ste. Marie International Bridge, Michigan Upper Peninsula: https://chrisizworski.com/sault-ste-marie-border-wait-time/
- U.S.-bound primary source: https://bwt.cbp.gov/
- Canada-bound primary source: https://www.cbsa-asfc.gc.ca/bwt-taf/menu-eng.html
- Approach roads and cameras: https://511on.ca/
- Truth rule: Canada-bound CBSA waits and U.S.-bound CBP waits remain separate. Passenger, commercial, standard, NEXUS, Ready Lane, and FAST records are never substituted for one another. Approach-road traffic, cameras, toll queues, and weather warnings are context and never alter the official border-processing delay.

## Michigan Beach Report

- Year-round beach explorer: https://chrisizworski.com/great-lakes-beaches/
- Seasonal daily ranking: https://chrisizworski.com/best-michigan-beaches-today/
- Coverage: 50 Michigan shoreline destinations on Lake Michigan, Lake Huron, Lake Superior, and Lake Erie, each with a canonical detail page.
- Primary notice source: https://mienviro.michigan.gov/nsite/beach/map/results
- Beach-hazard source: https://www.weather.gov/greatlakes/beachhazards
- Lake-observation source: https://www.ndbc.noaa.gov/
- Forecast source: https://open-meteo.com/en/docs
- Season rule: The daily ranking runs May 15 through September 15. Search, map, forecasts, lake observations, and official-notice checks remain available all year.
- Truth rule: “No active EGLE alert found” does not mean a recent sample exists and is not a guarantee of water quality. Official closures, contamination advisories, and matching beach hazards override the planning score and exclude a location from daily picks.
